description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'LeaveSearchFilterParams' used for specifying filter parameters when searching for leave requests within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base class 'FilterParams' and includes a property for leave request ID with getter and setter methods, as well as defining allowed sort fields.

classes.name: LeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering leave search results, allowing filtering by leave request ID and sorting by leave date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting the default sort field to 'leave.date'.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns the current leave request ID filter value.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Sets the leave request ID filter value.
